WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_custkey,
        c.c_nationkey,
        SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS customer_total
    FROM customer c
    JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) = 1995
    GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_nationkey
)

    r.r_name,
    AVG(ct.customer_total) AS avg_customer_total
FROM customer_totals ct
JOIN nation n ON ct.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
GROUP BY r.r_name
ORDER BY avg_customer_total DESC, r.r_name ASC

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) AS order_year,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.o_orderdate) AS order_month,
        ROUND(SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)), 2) AS total_revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
    JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
    WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#12'
      AND l.l_shipmode = 'AIR'
      AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01'
      AND o.o_orderdate <= DATE '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.o_orderdate)
)
SELECT
    order_year,
    order_month,
    total_revenue,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN LAG(total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY order_year, order_month) IS NULL THEN 0.00
            ELSE ((total_revenue - LAG(total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY order_year, order_month)) / LAG(total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY order_year, order_month)) * 100
        END
    , 2) AS mom_percentage_change
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY order_year, order_month

WITH customer_spending AS (
  SELECT 
    c.c_custkey,
    c.c_name,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spending
  FROM customer c
  JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
  JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
  JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
  WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'FURNITURE'
    AND o.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01'
    AND o.o_orderdate <= '1995-12-31'
    AND p.p_container = 'JUMBO BOX'
  GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name
),
bucketed_customers AS (
  SELECT 
    c_custkey,
    total_spending,
    CASE 
      WHEN total_spending >= 0 AND total_spending < 5000 THEN '0-5000'
      WHEN total_spending >= 5000 AND total_spending < 10000 THEN '5000-10000'
      WHEN total_spending >= 10000 THEN '10000+'
    END AS spending_bucket,
    CASE 
      WHEN total_spending >= 0 AND total_spending < 5000 THEN 0
      WHEN total_spending >= 5000 AND total_spending < 10000 THEN 5000
      WHEN total_spending >= 10000 THEN 10000
    END AS bucket_min
  FROM customer_spending
)
SELECT 
  spending_bucket,
  bucket_min,
  COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM bucketed_customers
GROUP BY spending_bucket, bucket_min
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
ORDER BY bucket_min ASC

```sql
WITH supplier_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        n.n_name,
        s.s_name,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) * (1 + l.l_tax)) AS total_revenue
    FROM
        lineitem l
    JOIN
        supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
    JOIN
        nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    WHERE
        l.l_shipmode = 'MAIL'
        AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.l_shipdate) = 1997
    GROUP BY
        n.n_name,
        s.s_name
)
SELECT
    n_name,
    s_name,
    total_revenue,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS supplier_rank
FROM
    supplier_revenue
WHERE
    supplier_rank <= 3
ORDER BY
    n_name ASC,
    supplier_rank ASC;
```
